correctness.rationale: For ordinary Mycielskian mu(C_n) with n>=5, the maximal open-neighborhood faces are the shadow simplex A, the apex triangles B_i and four-point original/shadow faces C_i. The apex-complement D strongly collapses onto A by x_i dominated by y_i. The apex link L is a step-2 cycle: one component if n odd, two if n even. The Mayer-Vietoris boundary H2(K;Z)~=H1(L;Z) thus determines integral ambient homotopy S2 or S1 wedge S2 wedge S2. Deleting x_j removes the relevant L loop. Deleting y_j leaves D-y_j with a single spoke circle; restriction L->D-y_j maps the component containing x_j with degree plus/minus one and any other component with degree zero. Naturality gives exactly the surviving parity image kernels. Each P_epsilon produces a primitive induced 2-sphere; factor-through-a-missing-vertex proves the image formula for every W. Independent direct neighborhood-face and mod2 boundary enumeration confirmed full and every one-vertex deletion for n=5,6,7,8 plus both parity-induced spheres for n=6,8. Infinite integral result rests on the deformation-retraction, unit degree, and natural MV proof.
